claimsPolicy: Every figure above is { value, measuredAt, source, kind } AND declares who authored the stamp. A figure this environment can read must carry `provenance: measured` plus the command and exit code that produced it — the emit script types none of those numbers, and the emitter refuses the whole write if one arrives hand-typed. A figure that cannot be read here is `declared-unmeasurable` with a reason and, where useful, a value explicitly labelled last known. Only figures with nothing to read may be attested by hand.

program.verificationCycleNote: The registry arrived GREEN this cycle and was read again after every write. The working tree arrived with a stale index — thirteen files staged as deleted that were present on disk, and four git locks left behind by an interrupted process hours earlier. Both were repaired before any work, the locks preserved rather than destroyed, and no tracked content was lost.
program.note: AO1 — the first screen, held to Rule 17 and Rule 14 at the same time. Nineteen cycles proved the operator's numbers cannot lie and one proved the customer's routes resolve; none had ever read what the first screen actually says. It is now extracted from disk with the navigation, header and footer chrome stripped, and fails by name on guarantee / money-back / risk-free language, on an experience claim past 15+ years, on the forbidden name, on a proof claim with no evidence, on a hard metric the measured feed does not carry, and — the finding this task exists for — on a first screen that is navigation and nothing else, as `no-claim-above-the-fold`. A bare noun is explicitly refused as a value claim, because the company name contains one and accepting it would have passed every page by accident. No page was rewritten to make the number look better. AO2 — the route from that screen to a conversation. A resolving link graph in which no prospect can reach a human is a working website and a dead business, so each entry point is walked out to the action that starts a conversation within 2 clicks, and the terminus must declare a delivery target on disk: a form that accepts a prospect's typing and sends it nowhere fails as a dead end rather than passing as a contact page. AO3 — this feed, emitted by measurement. Second messages sent: still zero.

workingTree.composition: This cycle's changes are the staged-action guard and its data module, two new test suites, their registration in the runner and the tracked record-dependency manifest, the emitter payload, and the regenerated status feed. Scanned for credentials, keys, environment files and dependency directories: 0 hits. The off-limits personal folder was never read, listed or referenced.
workingTree.howItWasUnblocked: The full registry ran against the operator's real repository as the first action of the cycle and again after every write, each result read from its own exit code.
workingTree.stillBlocked: The commits exist locally and cannot be pushed. The credential refusal was reproduced against the real remote this cycle. Committed is strictly better than uncommitted, and is not the same as landed.

lanes.detail: Drafted for fourteen days, readable on disk for less than one. This cycle asserted the send sheet against the module's real output in both directions — every drafted handle is in the file, and the file names no handle the module never drafted — so the artefact is proven, not asserted. Sent: zero. That number is a human action away and is reported as such without softening.

A staged action must name a readable artefact or state plainly that it has none and why. Neither declaration, both declarations, a named file that is absent or empty, or prose claiming a drafted thing while declaring no artefact — each fails by its own name. The status emitter refuses to write a feed that carries one.

blockers.fix: A guard that refuses the claim rather than reporting it. Red against the exact wording that rode for two weeks, green against the fix, and wired into the emitter so the feed cannot carry one.

needsAhmad.what: Ten emails and two call scripts, keyed by opaque handle to routes the prospects supplied themselves. Roughly twenty minutes of copy and paste.
needsAhmad.why: The only item on this list that can move a business number. Until these go out the offer stays untested: 124 cycles of build have never produced a second touch, and a cold sequence produces most of its replies on touches two through four.
needsAhmad.unblocks: The only thing on this list that can produce a reply, a meeting, or a first dollar. Every other item moves code or infrastructure; this one moves the business.
needsAhmad.blockedWithout: The offer stays untested indefinitely. Revenue, meetings and replies all stay at zero no matter how many cycles run, because nothing else here can move them.

needsAhmad.why: It would retire the push above permanently instead of re-staging it every cycle. Highest leverage item here that is not a conversation.
needsAhmad.noArtefact: Nothing can be prepared on disk for this. It is a credential granted in someone else's account settings, and an agent must never hold or create one.
needsAhmad.unblocks: Retires the push above permanently instead of re-staging it every cycle. It is the only item here that removes another item from this list rather than adding a click to it.
needsAhmad.blockedWithout: The push stays a manual step, re-staged and re-explained every single cycle, forever. Nineteen cycles of that have already happened.

needsAhmad.item: Push the shared line to the code host
needsAhmad.what: One push of the shared branch, every commit on it verified against a green full registry.
needsAhmad.why: The build sandbox holds no code-host credential and that refusal was reproduced against the real remote again this cycle. This is the only thing between verified work and the shared host.
needsAhmad.unblocks: Moves every verified commit onto the shared host, where it can be deployed and where a second machine can see it. Prerequisite for publishing.
needsAhmad.blockedWithout: The verified line keeps growing on one machine only — a single-disk failure loses it, and the publish below cannot happen at all.

needsAhmad.what: One deliberate operator action in the hosting dashboard.
needsAhmad.why: Landing a branch never deploys. This stays a separate human decision, and it is the action that starts the visit log recording — until it happens the passive signal reads not-yet-collecting rather than zero.
needsAhmad.noArtefact: A publish is a button in the hosting provider's own interface. There is no local object for it, and staging one would be theatre.
needsAhmad.unblocks: Starts the visit log recording, which is the only path to a passive signal that does not depend on anyone answering a message.
needsAhmad.blockedWithout: The passive signal reads not-yet-collecting rather than zero — honest, and worth nothing. No prospect can reach the site at all.
